title: Momentum Equations
description: Essential Criteria: The equations for conservation of momentum must be correctly stated.

title: Energy Equation
description: Essential Criteria: The equation for conservation of energy must be correctly stated.

title: Correct Angles
description: Important Criteria: The angles used in the equations must be correctly identified for back scattering.

title: Final Energy Expression
description: Essential Criteria: The final expression for the scattered photon's energy must be derived correctly.

title: Sign Errors
description: Pitfall Criteria: Common sign mistakes in the equations should be avoided.

title: Units Consistency
description: Optional Criteria: Units must be consistent throughout the calculations.

title: Derivation Steps
description: Important Criteria: Key steps in the derivation process must be clearly shown.
